name: net_ready_mash_keeps_the_link
description: Mashing N (Ready) 40 times at 30 a second keeps the link: one READY is on its way at a time and the last press wins, so far fewer than the server's 10-command burst go out. Orders beyond the mirrored command bucket are refused here with 'Not so fast', not by the server. A game that sends around the bucket is refused by the server with ERROR 8, and the strip gives the server's reason.

steps.msg: the link held through the mashing

steps.assert: not Game.is_ready() and not node('BuildController').wants_ready() and node('PartyStrip').lines()[0] == 'Tamsin 120'
steps.msg: 40 presses end where they began: not Ready, as the last press asked
the presses are coalesced under the mirrored bucket: at most 8 at once and 5 a second (14 in 80 frames) went out for 40 presses, none refused

steps.assert: not Game.can_command() and Game.command_refusal() == 'Not so fast'
steps.msg: the client's mirror of the command bucket ran dry, with tokens kept back

steps.assert: not node('BuildController').build('arrow', Vector2i(8, 3)) and node('Notice').text == 'Not so fast' and node('Pending_8_3') == null
steps.msg: an order now is refused here, and says why
a moment later it goes out

steps.assert: scene.client.error_text == 'Message rate exceeded' and node('NetStatusText').text == 'Link lost · Message rate exceeded'
steps.msg: around the bucket the server refuses the connection, and the strip gives its reason
